description: Removal of condition 4 (opening hours) attached to planning permission ref: 2023/1946 dated 17/10/2023. The effect of the removed condition would be to allow the premises to operate within unrestricted hours (24 hours a day, 7 days a week).
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

<p>Improvements to the building fabric, recommended by the noise report prepared by Archo Consulting, approved under condition 2 of this permission, shall be implemented prior to the occupation of the unit. </p><p>REASON: In the interests of protecting the amenity of neighbouring properties and the character of the street scene</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the commencement of the 24 hour operations hereby permitted, precise details of the security measures to be incorporated into the premises shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall demonstrate how the development will achieve the principles and objectives of 'Secured by Design'. The approved security measures shall be implemented in full prior to the first 24 hour operations, and shall thereafter be permanently retained and maintained for the lifetime of the development.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b478f03e-7fff-39ed-9896-8e131d574029"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.3800000000000001;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:12pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In the interest of amenity, crime prevention, and to ensure the development creates a safe environment.</span></p>

<p>The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the three years beginning with the date of planning permission ref: 2023/1946.</p><p>REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).</p>
